chapter.heading: The Family of David
chapter.v:
the fifth,
Shephatiah, by Abital; the sixth, Ithream, by his wife Eglah. [Lev. 10:1,]

These six
were born to him in Hebron. There he reigned seven years and six months, and in Jerusalem he reigned thirty-three years.

And these
were born to him in Jerusalem: Shimea, Shobab, Nathan, and Solomon—four by Bathshua the daughter of Ammiel.

Also there
were Ibhar, Elishama, Eliphelet,
Nogah, Nepheg, Japhia,

Elishama, Eliada,
and Eliphelet—nine in all. [2 Sam. 8:17 e]

These were
all the sons of David, besides the sons of the concubines, and Tamar their sister.The Family of Solomon

Solomon’s son
was Rehoboam; Abijah was his son, Asa his son, Jehoshaphat his son, [2 Chr. 26:17,]

Joram his
son, Ahaziah his son, Joash his son, [Ezra 7:3 i 2 Chr. 19:11 1 Chr. 9:11]

Amaziah his
son, Azariah his son, Jotham his son,

Ahaz his
son, Hezekiah his son, Manasseh his son,

Amon his
son, and Josiah his son. [2 Kin. 25:18- 21; Neh. 11:11]

The sons
of Josiah were Johanan the firstborn, the second Jehoiakim, the third Zedekiah, and the fourth Shallum. [2 Kin. 25:21]

The sons
of Jehoiakim were Jeconiah his son and Zedekiah his son.The Family of Jeconiah [Gen. 46:11; Ex. 6:16]

And the
sons of Jeconiah were Assir, Shealtiel his son,

and Malchiram,
Pedaiah, Shenazzar, Jecamiah, Hoshama, and Nedabiah. [1 Kin. 6:1;]

The sons
of Pedaiah were Zerubbabel and Shimei. The sons of Zerubbabel were Meshullam, Hananiah, Shelomith their sister,

and Hashubah,
Ohel, Berechiah, Hasadiah, and Jushab-Hesed—five in all. [1 Chr. 6:42]

The sons
of Hananiah were Pelatiah and Jeshaiah, the sons of Rephaiah, the sons of Arnan, the sons of Obadiah, and the sons of Shechaniah.

The son
of Shechaniah was Shemaiah. The sons of Shemaiah were Hattush, Igal, Bariah, Neariah, and Shaphat—six in all. [Num. 16:1]

The sons
of Neariah were Elioenai, Hezekiah, and Azrikam—three in all.

The sons
of Elioenai were Hodaviah, Eliashib, Pelaiah, Akkub, Johanan, Delaiah, and Anani—seven in all.
